_comment: Experiment configuration template (config_version 1). Copy, rename and edit. Relative paths are resolved against THIS file's directory. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. See annotation_qc/dashboard/README.md.

experiment.title: My species: reference vs predictors
experiment.description: Which prediction files, which reference, and why.

evaluation._comment: evaluation_mode: all | protein_coding | cds_only | canonical. Biotype lists filter genes / transcripts (empty = no filter). genome_mismatch: error | warn | exclude.

policies._comment_policies: Policy ids are free identifiers. Selections: all | longest_cds | canonical. 'canonical' uses the Ensembl_canonical tag (longest CDS where a gene has none) and is reported unavailable for references without any tag.

references.annotation_release: release or date; write 'unknown' if unknown

annotation_preparation._comment: Optional, recorded steps: 'decompress' (needed for gzip files not named *.gz) and {'name': 'retype_transcript_types', 'types': [...]} for transcript types the parser does not list (validation tells you). reuse_existing adopts an already prepared file only if re-deriving it from the source gives the same sha256.

scope._comment: type: all | reference_sequence_regions (##sequence-region names in the reference) | sequences (list below) | regions_file (path). Decide before comparing tools.

references.notes: How the assembly identity was checked.

runs.provenance: Command, date, model weights, masking, evidence used. Leave fields null when unknown: they are shown as unknown.
A second run of the same tool: run_id, not tool, is the identifier.

import._comment: Optional. Only for registering completed comparisons from an existing benchmark directory without rerunning them.
